fullContent:
Mahayograj Guggul – Benefits, Usage, Indications and Dosage 
 Reference: Sharangadhara samhita Madhyama khanda 7/56-69 
 Introduction 
 Mahayograj Guggul is a well-known and multipurpose Ayurvedic medicine in tablet form that balances all the three Doshas – Vata, Pitta and Kapha. This tablet has Guggulu (Commiphora mukul) as its base. It is useful in many diseases. It has strong rejuvenative action, and anti-inflammatory and anti-arthritic properties and detoxifies body. It must always be taken under strict medical supervision. 
 Ingredients 
 
 Ginger (Zingiber officinale) – 3 g 
 Long pepper (Piper longum) – 3 g 
 Chavya (Piper retrofractum) – 3 g 
 Pippali mool (Long pepper root) – 3 g 
 Hingu (Ferula asafoetida) – 3 g 
 Chitraka (Plumbago zeylancia) – 3 g 
 Ajamoda (Trachyspermum roxburghianum) – 3 g 
 Shweta jeeraka (Cuminum cyminum) – 3 g 
 Krishna jeeraka (Carum carvi) – 3 g 
 Renuka (Vitex agnus) – 3 g 
 Indrayava (Holarrhena antidysenterica) – 3 g 
 Patha (Cissampelos pariera) – 3 g 
 Vidanga (Embelia ribes) – 3 g 
 Gaja pippali (Scindapsus officinalis) – 3 g 
 Katuka (Picrorihiza kurroa) – 3 g 
 Ativisha (Aconitum heterophyllum) – 3 g 
 Bharngi (Clerodendron serratum) – 3 g 
 Vacha (Acorus calamus) – 3 g 
 Murva (Marsdenia tenacissima) – 3 g 
 Triphala – Haritaki (Terminalia chebula), Vibhitaki (Terminalia bellirica), Amla (Emblica officinalis) – 40 g each 
 Purified resin of Shuddha Guggulu (Commiphora mukul) – 180 g 
 Vanga Bhasma – 48 g 
 Roupya Bhasma – 48 g 
 Naga Bhasma – 48 g 
 Loha Bhasma – 48 g 
 Abhraka Bhasma – 48 g 
 Mandura Bhasma – 48 g 
 Rasasindhura – 48 g 
 
 Method of Preparation 
 Heat process is used in its manufacturing. The Guggulu (gum resin) is melted along with water. Then the remaining ingredients are added to it, and semisolid paste is made which is rolled to tablet form. 
 Dosage 
 Use 1-2 tablets, 2-3 times a day, before or after having your meals or as suggested by Ayurvedic doctor. 
 Therapeutic Uses 
 
 Mahayograj Guggul is extensively used Ayurvedic treatment for gout, it decreases joint swelling and pain. 
 Effective in Haemorrhoids, piles, anal Fistula, Diseases of abdomen and can reduce the pain in umbilical region. 
 Provides beneficial effects in musculoskeletal disorders and nerve pain, Epilepsy as well in diabetes. 
 Benefits in Malabsorption syndrome 
 Reduces stiffness’ and tightness in the chest 
 Improves the Tastelessness 
 Good to use in Colicky Pain, Urinary disorders, Obesity, Rat poisoning, Eye disorder. 
 Beneficial in Phthisis, Dyspnea/Asthma, Cough, sprue Anemia. 
 Efficient in vitiation of semen, menstrual disorder, Infertility. 
 
 Contraindications/ Side Effects 
 
 It is better to use this product under medical supervision. 
 Self-medication with this medicine is discouraged. 
 Very high dose than prescribed may lead to stomach irritation. 
 
 
 Note:- This is pure classical Ayurvedic medicine and should be strictly consumed only after prescription of an Ayurvedic doctor and to be taken under medical supervision only.
